title: UI core kit
summary: Bingkai Navy foundation every screen uses: the restyled shadcn primitives, page layout (Page, PageHeader, SectionCard, SummaryCard), StatusBadge with fixed tones, Notice, empty/error/404 states, skeletons, DescriptionList, Money/Qty/DocNumber, Modal, FormSheet, and id-ID formatters.
when_to_use: Any project with screens — every other kit and every module with a frontend builds on it.
when_not_to_use: Never skipped when a module has a frontend.
